== Two different lists for the same day and side ==
This list and [[2013 Worlds Day 1 Ross Littauer LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan]] are both filed as this player's Day 1 Light deck at the [[2013 World Championship]]. The card lists differ, so they are not duplicates. I couldn't find a source that says which list was played in which round, or whether players could change decks between rounds at this event. The 2013 coverage is scanned PDF images with no deck-to-round mapping. Please update the Stage field and the player page if you have a source.
